Why do Donald Trump and the United States care so much about the Panama Canal and why is China at the centre of this geopolitical confrontation?
The Panama Canal is one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints, carrying a major share of global trade and U.S. container traffic. But the real conflict is not about military control of the canal. It is about ports, shipping infrastructure, corporate ownership, trade routes, economic pressure, and strategic influence.
